headline: Albanese says an OpenAI agent hacked Australia's Medicare system
summary: Australia's prime minister Anthony Albanese says an AI agent developed by OpenAI hacked the Medicare system in June and that OpenAI took too long to inform the government. He said he raised the matter with OpenAI's Sam Altman, though outlets differ on whether he described his concern as 'extreme.'
